Over the time it has been in the game, it has been significantly remade multiple times. ==Design & Path== {{tabber |Current |The current version of '''Medieval Times''' is a village with fourteen wooden houses. Several wooden fences, barrels, trees and rocks are scattered across the map. Wooden lanterns are also by the path. A well and a wooden cart with hay bales on the back can also be found on the map. Multiple grass small hills are dotted around the map. The yellow pebble path begins and ends at a cave. The path takes multiple turns, avoiding the houses. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Medieval Times''' was an island with six wooden houses seen around the island. Several wooden gates and trees were scattered across the map. Lanterns were also by the path. The entire map was on an island surrounded by water. Several grass hills and trees were dotted around the map, with a significant hill range spanning the south of the island (with the entrance being the north). The brown stone path began at a cave and ended at an open area with hay bales. It took an indirect route to avoid the houses and the large hill range. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Medieval Times''' was identical to the third version, except baseplate water surrounded the map, instead of terrain water. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Medieval Times''' was a compact Medieval Village, which consisted of seven houses with some trees, wells and a two stone arcs near a cliff by three of the houses. Other hills and pitched tents could be seen around the map. The brown stone path began and ended at two caves inside two of the hills. It took a circular route around the map. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Map:Medieval Times}} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal}} ==Strategy== *The main placement of ground towers should be near the middle of the map, where most of the cliffs are located. **This area is also useful for cliff towers, as it has a few cliffs which are somewhat close to each other. *When placed on the cliffs near the middle of the map, cliff towers can cover a large amount of the path. **Cliff towers can cover even more of the path. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} MedievalTimes.png|First version (18 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) Medieval Times New..png|Second and third versions (13 October 2019 – 4 February 2023) {{GalleryHeader|View}} Med.png|First version (18 June 2019 – 13 October 2019) MTView.png|Second version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) MedView.png|Third version (29 October 2020 – 4 February 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} SpringFrenzyPI.png|Current version on the game thumbnail. MedievalTimesDI3.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== [[File:MedievalTimesGladiatorVacation.png|thumb|Level 0 [[Gladiator]] seen farming in second and third versions of '''Medieval Times'''.|225px]] *The [[Gladiator]] could have been seen farming on the second and third versions of this map, supposedly on vacation. **This was intended as a joke as the [[Gladiator]] was unable to be used between the 13th of October 2019 and the 29th of November 2019. ***This Easter egg was still in the map regardless of the fact that the [[Gladiator]] can be used again until 4th of February 2023, when '''Medieval Times''' received a remake. **Despite the [[Gladiator]] getting its skin color and face changed, the [[Gladiator]] on the map still had yellow skin and uses the default Roblox face, essentially retaining its Pre-[[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul]] look. *This map was remade as part of the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] to give it a mid-poly look. ==Update History== *'''18 June 2019''' - [[BETA v1.1|BETA v1.1.1]] **'''Medieval Times''' added. *'''5 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.8|BETA v1.8.0]] **{{Color|OldNormal}} difficulty removed. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Medieval Times''' remade. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **Baseplate water replaced with terrain water. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Medieval Times''' remade. **Made playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. **No longer playable in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. {{MapNavBox}}
